We’re delighted you’re considering South Loop for your child’s education. In our vibrant international school community, your child will excel academically, personally, and socially. You’ll find BIS Chicago, South Loop’s admissions criteria and entry requirements here.

Admissions

Read more +
  • Admissions
  • Entry requirements

The British International School of Chicago, South Loop is open to children aged 3-18. We accept applications all year round and new students can start at any time. After making an inquiry , you’ll join us for a school tour, either in person or virtually. You’ll then fill in our online application form and submit some supporting documents. Depending on the age group you’re applying for, we’ll then invite your child to a shadow day and/or age-appropriate assessment(s). ENTRY REQUIREMENTS: NURSERY, RECEPTION, YEARS 1–2 The start of a child’s school career is arguably the most crucial time for development. That’s why we make sure we have the facilities and staff to help your young child settle in and thrive at South Loop. Here’s everything you need to apply. Application checklist: Nursery, Reception, Years 1–2 • Application form ($100) • Information About Your Child (document provided by Admissions team) • School progress reports • Teacher Evaluation Form • Parent meeting • Student playdate or Shadow day ENTRY REQUIREMENTS: YEARS 3–6 In Primary School, your child’s eyes are opened wide to a whole world of fascinating concepts. It’s a time for making new friends, discovering their identity, and developing a love for learning. Here’s everything you need to apply. Application checklist: Years 3–6 • Application form ($100) • Information About Your Child (document provided by Admissions team) • School progress reports • Teacher Evaluation Form • Parent meeting • Shadow Day ENTRY REQUIREMENTS: YEARS 7–9 In Middle School, your child truly begins to discover who they are. They experience dramatic growth both emotionally and cognitively—so we need to be sure we can accommodate their needs entirely. Here’s everything you need to apply. Application checklist: Years 7–9 • Application form ($100) • Applicant Statement ( document provided by Admissions team ) • Information About Your Child (document provided by Admissions team) • School progress reports/transcripts • English evaluation form • Math evaluation form • Administration evaluation form • Shadow day • Meeting with student (scheduled after paperwork is received) • Standardized testing (e.g. ISEE, SSAT MAP, PSAT) (optional) • TOEFL or TOEFL Jr. (required for students who have limited English) ENTRY REQUIREMENTS : YEARS 10–13 College is on the horizon – so the next few years are paramount to your child’s future. That means we need to make absolutely sure we have everything they need to flourish, and follow the path they desire. Here’s everything you need to apply. Application checklist: Years 10–13 • Application form ($100) • Applicant Statement ( document provided by Admissions team ) • Information About Your Child (document provided by Admissions team) • School progress reports/transcripts • English evaluation form • Math evaluation form • Administration evaluation form • Shadow day • Meeting with student (scheduled after paperwork is received) • Standardized testing (e.g. ISEE, SSAT MAP, PSAT) (optional) • TOEFL or TOEFL Jr. (required for students who have limited English)
